_comment: A long (~11255s), cyclical episode -- 383 jobs across 13 phases: quiet -> bottleneck -> quiet -> standoff -> quiet -> burst -> quiet -> starvation -> quiet -> bottleneck (repeat) -> quiet -> standoff (repeat) -> quiet_cooldown. Every stress phase's job count is picked from a target utilization so it sustains real pressure for close to its full nominal duration, not a spike that drains in seconds -- v1 of this scenario was too small for any of this to show up as more than an arrival spike. bottleneck/standoff each appear twice so a rule's second encounter with the same regime can be compared directly against its first. See _phases for exact start/end/n_jobs per phase.
name: compound_scenario
